verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a remote-desktop app, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no API. OpenAPI paths and llms.txt all return 404. The `swift run SillHost` command-line host and Homebrew install are build and install tooling, not an API that mirrors UI actions such as launching apps, managing windows or changing settings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
